text:
Once Human - Producer Deep Dive | PS5 Games
https://www.playstation.com/games/once-human/

Bigger Screen. Closer Fear. Once Human (F2P) arrives on PlayStation 5 on August 25. 

Sit down with Producer Vincent to see how Once Human leverages the power of the PS5 to amplify the thrill of strange worlds survival. Switch seamlessly into the First-Person View and step into pitch-black abandoned buildings, where the fear of the unknown becomes incredibly real.
We’ve deeply adapted the combat experience for your controller. Feel the distinct adaptive trigger resistance with every weapon you fire, and experience nuanced haptic feedback that delivers true recoil right into your hands. Every vibration conveys vital battlefield information against the Anomalous.
Team up with friends, build your territory, and seize power from the anomalies that hunt you.
Survive Together, We were Once Human.
